name: voiceup-ai
description: VOICEUP AI - an AI voice and communication coach built on React + Vite, Firebase and Netlify.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix functions install
scripts.dev:functions: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,auth,storage
scripts.build: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix functions run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix functions run test && npm --prefix web run test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix functions run lint
scripts.verify: npm run check:secrets && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.deploy:functions: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase deploy --only functions,firestore:rules,storage
